agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: The agents in this Microsoft Foundry project. Creating and publishing versions happens here — no portal needed.
agents.emptyBody: An agent brings together instructions, tools and a knowledge base. Once you publish the first one, it shows up here with its version history.

login.note: Answers cite their source and respect each document's access. That is why we need to know who is asking.

console.sourcesEmpty: The sources an answer cites appear here — every claim grounded in the base, never assumed.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.subtitle: Real tickets opened by the human approval flow — the create_ticket tool only fires after someone approves.
tickets.emptyBody: When an agent proposes opening a ticket and someone approves it, it shows up here.

evals.title: Evaluations
evals.subtitle: Gate results: the deterministic policy and the Foundry judges over the golden set.
evals.emptyBody: Run the cloud eval to populate this page — results land in the Foundry portal and here.

admin.usersSubtitle: The Entra roles that govern who approves, who edits and who only reads.
admin.connectionsSubtitle: The Foundry connections this tenant uses. We never store a secret — we reference the connection.

overview.title: Overview
overview.tagline: An assurance mechanism on top of Microsoft Foundry.
